title: VN Stage character file
description: The optional vn-stage.json beside a character's or form's portrait. See art-format.md.

label.description: The name shown in the module. Default: the folder name.

portrait.description: The neutral portrait, relative to this folder. Default: portrait.*

avatar.description: The small picture for lists. Default: avatar.*, else the portrait.

expressions.description: Expression name (the file name without its extension) to label. Sets the order and the labels.

scale.description: Default height as a multiple of the frame height.

yOffset.description: Default drop from standing on the bottom edge, as a share of the frame height. Positive is lower.

groups.description: The older name of `tags`; read together with it.
